alt: Grouped bars for each year from 2021 to 2025. January sign-ups: 23.4%, 27.1%, 24.1%, 27.5%, 29.8%. Average of other months: 14.7%, 15.6%, 15.3%, 16.1%, 24.7%. 2025 covers January to September, so its other months are February to September.
caption: January sign-ups had the highest activation of each year from 2021 to 2024, between 23.4% and 27.5%. The other months averaged 14.7% to 16.1% in those years. In 2025, February to September averaged 24.7%.
